source.frame_definition: zero-based ordinal from sequential decoded source frames, verified by exact decoded pixel hash and actual FFmpeg PTS
source.pts_provenance: OpenCV FFmpeg CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC after sequential decoded source frame; timestamps are not assumed to equal ordinal/fps

annotation_policy: Only manually observed visible ring centers. No interpolation or inferred coordinates counted as observations. Original split membership preserved. No fresh holdout or old test episode used.

mapping.disclaimer: Approximate image-plane XY based on known 50 mm bearing outer diameter; no camera calibration or metric 3D ground truth.
